rules.description: Devon Labs pages — anonymous HTML cache
rules.expression: (http.request.full_uri in {"https://devonlabs.space/" "https://devonlabs.space/work/" "https://devonlabs.space/software/" "https://devonlabs.space/film/" "https://devonlabs.space/photography/" "https://devonlabs.space/coffee/" "https://devonlabs.space/shop/"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] in {"authorization" "range" "rsc"}))

(http.request.full_uri in {"https://devonlabs.space/" "https://devonlabs.space/work/" "https://devonlabs.space/software/" "https://devonlabs.space/film/" "https://devonlabs.space/photography/" "https://devonlabs.space/coffee/" "https://devonlabs.space/shop/"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] in {"authorization" "range" "rsc"})) and http.response.code eq 200 and any(http.response.headers["content-type"][*] contains "text/html") and not any(http.response.headers.names[*] eq "set-cookie")
